title: Space Weather
description: The Sun blows a wind of plasma at four hundred kilometres a second, and now and then hurls a cloud of it. The Earth's field stands it off where the wind's pressure balances the field's, ten Earth radii out; in a storm the boundary is pushed in, currents surge through the ground and every long conductor, and aurorae light the night. Geomagnetic storms now come every few days: consoles and multiblocks in the Overworld run at 70% while one lasts. Unlocks the Heliograph and the Faraday Mesh, which shields a machine from them.

puzzle.goal: The solar wind (density ρ, speed v) presses on the Earth's dipole field, whose pressure falls as B₀²/(2μ₀)·(R/r)⁶. Write the stand-off distance r of the magnetopause, in Earth radii R, where the two pressures balance.
puzzle.name: The Chapman–Ferraro stand-off
puzzle.ask: Find r in Earth radii for B₀ = 3.1e-5 T, μ₀ = 1.2566e-6, ρ = @{rho} kg/m³ and v = @{v} m/s.
puzzle.method: Pressure balance: ρv² = B²/(2μ₀) with B = B₀(R/r)³; solve for r/R.
